answer: To resist Sybil attacks, agents must stake capital along a verification voyage across network graph partitions. A game-theoretic multi-agent auditing protocol verifies each topological cut: an agent cluster anchored at an entry jetty must pass peer audits within a validator grove to transact. Coordinated false attestations trigger deterministic stake slashing. By enforcing sparse bottleneck cuts, attacker cost scales superlinear to swarm size.
